name: Basic Web Research to Ddoc
query: Research the current state of WebAssembly adoption in production applications and create a summary ddoc
expected_behavior: Searches the web for 'WebAssembly adoption production 2025' or similar queries
Performs at least 2 web searches with varied terms
Searches existing ddocs for 'WebAssembly' to avoid duplicates
Selects Research Summary format (general research request)
Structures content with Executive Summary, Key Findings, Detailed Analysis, Sources sections
Includes inline citations using [Title](URL) markdown links
Includes a Sources section listing all referenced URLs
Uses descriptive title with topic and date
Waits for blockchain sync to complete
Returns the blockchain-synced link to the user
success_criteria: Research Summary format used with correct sections
At least 3 sources cited using [Title](URL) format
Content is well-structured with headings and bullet points
